author: NASS
description:
I colorized, fully restored, and created the sound design for these rare archival images that chronicle daily life in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin, in 1938. This historical film offers a fascinating glimpse into the town’s streets, its surroundings, and daily life from nearly nine decades ago.

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to 4K quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
✔ Full restoration: stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring made with my own AviSynth and VapourSynth scripts

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made only for the ambiance and do not represent real historical data.

B&W Video Source: B&W Video Source: The Sun Prairie Volunteer Fire Department and Amateur Service Productions

title: Wisconsin 1930s in color, Sun Prarie [60fps, Remastered] w/Sound Design

author: NASS
description:
i colorized, restored, and created a sound design for this video, filmed in Chicago in 1925.

It moves from the busy downtown streets to State & Monroe, Western Avenue, the Lake Michigan shore and a boat on the Chicago River. Then come Dr. and Mrs. Drane’s home and the crowd leaving Friendship Baptist Church on its 10th anniversary, before an ending on the Illinois River.

The source is a black-and-white film. I restored it frame by frame, colorized it, and built a new soundscape to bring 1920s Chicago back to life.

Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second 
✔ Image resolution boosted up to HD 
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness 
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔added sound only for the ambiance
✔restoration:(stabilisation,denoise,cleand,deblur) 

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made only for the ambiance and do not represent real historical data.

B&W Video Source: Solomon S
